status: Live probe completed 2026-10-15: 12 films and 9 anchor identities resolved; one book anchor omitted by Insights under both reviewed editions. Full-input audit failed; independent planner remains available.
scenario: Fictional 100-seat mixed-arts venue. Each example community declares three cultural anchors.
booking_scope: Public catalogues provide research and enquiry destinations. A booking requires a distributor response covering the UK territory, venue, dates, screening format and commercial terms.
runtime_scope: Planning durations reproduce the named official source and edition. Confirm the supplied DCP or other exhibition-copy duration before fixing the final running order.
editorial_scope: Literature/city and music/performance labels describe the pool. Every ranking uses the same full shortlist.

films.name: La Haine
films.creator: Mathieu Kassovitz
films.runtime_edition: BFI 30th-anniversary theatrical listing; BFI distribution spreadsheet lists DCP at 98mins.
films.curatorial_rationale: Urban friendship, social division and a single-day structure provide a discussion-led city-life programme.
films.booking_notes: Current downloadable BFI catalogue: sheet2 rows 532 (DCP) and 533 (DVD). Ask for the proposed UK screening date and supplied edition.

films.name: Network
films.creator: Sidney Lumet
films.curatorial_rationale: Media institutions, public speech and commercial pressure connect a reading-group debate to cinema.
films.booking_notes: Ask Park Circus for the named UK venue/date, available screening edition and full licence quotation.

films.name: Daisies

films.runtime_edition: Second Run BD016, 1080/24fps Blu-ray, released 22 October 2018.

films.booking_notes: Source documents the home-video edition. Ask Second Run for the current UK public-screening licensor and available exhibition formats. Public role contact: info@secondrundvd.com.
